collection.title: Volvo XC40 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Volvo XC40 2017 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this XC40 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
